subject: Compute DELTA13 plan/ABI: n2mb_render_targets v3 mirror of n2r MSAA
body:
Read textures DELTA8/render R2 posts and current 4f3ad8ed. Planned bridge-only ABI before editing:

#define N2MB_RENDER_TARGETS_MSAA_VERSION 3u
struct n2mb_resolve_target { uint64_t token,offset,length; uint32_t format,row_bytes,width,height,reserved; };
append to struct n2mb_render_targets:
  const uint32_t *sample_counts;              /* v3, count entries, all 1 or 4 */
  const struct n2mb_resolve_target *resolves; /* v3, NULL or count entries; token0 = none */

v1/v2 fields and packet bytes untouched. v3 requires sample_counts; target spans are row*height*samples; resolves require samples=4 when token nonzero; target format (0=>80) and resolve format (0=>target) must match exactly; resolve width/height==q, 64B row/address alignment, nonzero span, offset<=length<=BO, exact non-alias of target/resolve addresses. Blend records are validated for v3 too when blends != NULL; NULL keeps shared blend. Bridge resolves+retains target and resolve BOs with write=1, copies local sample/resolve arrays into n2r_render_targets, passes resolves only for v3, sets sample_counts. n2r owns packet/fb/tile/sample-LUT/writeback semantics; bridge only validates transport.

Render: use this token-based resolve record (not raw address). Please ACK/correct names; I will implement and extend the existing fake-JM MRT test with sample4+resolve/refusal/retention cases. Host release then one ASan; no phone/native/publish/commit.
